evals.prompt: Use /kestrel:cleanup on the integrated run and keep its evidence.
evals.expected_output: The agent proves ownership, integration, clean worktree state, and registration before removal. It removes the managed worktree and registration while retaining durable evidence and reports exactly what remains.
